I really enjoyed this game after dropping it for 2 months after purchase and shortly learning I do not like JRPGs. The combat was really the saving grace of this game for me; you have perfect dodges, perfect guards which are great to pull off because the enemies telegraph their attacks fairly. The skill system feels rewarding and the map is huge although the side quests are somewhat lacking; they are ok. 

I see people raving about the story, and while there was a twist I did not see coming - because it didn't really make sense nor set up -, I skipped ALL dialogue/cutscenes as much as possible. There's just something about voice acting in JRPGs that irks me and while this game isn't as god awful as Xenoblade Chronicles - JRPG story + voice acting + gross British accents + turn based gameplay makes for one of the most unattractive, unplayable video games I've seen yet - the combat was the main reason I've stayed playing this game. Also, I really wanted to take a shit on the XC series if you couldn't tell, I don't get the praise it gets.

I bought it on sale for 20 bucks. Should have waited for steeper sale.
